references.description: Blueprint Editor overview with title, action strip, icon slots, settings, preview, and save action.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Inventory slots are 40 logical pixels at 100% Factorio UI scale.
requiredBehavior: Editor hierarchy and control order match the game reference.

references.description: Blueprint Editor green Upgrade button and its tooltip.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: The tool button uses the source-defined Blueprint Settings action-slot geometry.
requiredBehavior: Upgrade action and tooltip states match the game reference.

references.description: Upgrade-planner selection library with Default Upgrade, stored planners, six-card rows, and view controls.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Grid mode contains six source-defined large record cards per row.
requiredBehavior: Planner selection applies immediately in application mode.

references.description: Blueprint Editor with a selected planner held at the Upgrade button.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: The held planner occupies the same action-slot footprint as the Upgrade launcher.
requiredBehavior: Placed-planner state exposes apply and replacement actions.

references.description: Blueprint parametrisation window with evaluation-order guidance, parameter row, close, and confirm.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Dialog controls use the source-defined frame and button metrics at 100% UI scale.
requiredBehavior: Evaluation order, parameter controls, close, and confirm remain keyboard accessible.

references.description: Select-a-signal window with category tabs, ten-slot rows, search, quality strip, and confirm.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Category tabs are 71 by 72 logical pixels and body rows contain ten slots.
requiredBehavior: Categories fill six-column rows and subgroup breaks pad ten-slot rows.

references.description: Blueprint component removal with tooltip, red zero-count slot, and modified preview.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Component inventory slots are 40 logical pixels at 100% UI scale.
requiredBehavior: Removed components remain visible, reversible, and described by a tooltip.

references.description: Blueprint Editor Filters section with Modules, Entities, and Tiles.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Checkbox rows use the Blueprint Settings source-defined table spacing.
requiredBehavior: Conditional filter categories reflect the blueprint contents.

references.description: Upgrade Planner mapper grid with title, tools, four From/To groups, and fixed inventory slots.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Each mapper pair is 80 logical pixels and each row contains four pairs.
requiredBehavior: Whole mapper pairs drag; visible up/down mapper buttons do not exist.

references.description: Set-the-filter source picker with category rows, subgroup rows, quality strip, and confirm.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Category tabs are 71 by 72 logical pixels and body rows contain ten slots.
requiredBehavior: Confirming a From value returns to the planner without opening To.

references.description: Quality comparator menu with Any quality and the seven comparison operators.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Comparator entries use the source-defined Quality Condition menu row height.
requiredBehavior: Any quality is represented by an empty condition.

references.description: Configured From slot for assembling-machine-2 with a less-than-or-equal Rare quality condition.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Mapper endpoint slots use the source-defined 40 logical-pixel inventory slot.
requiredBehavior: The configured source renders both signal and quality comparator.

references.description: Restricted Select-upgrade target picker with compatible assembler family and quality strip.
references.logicalScaleAnchor: Target results use source-defined ten-slot rows and the standard quality strip.
requiredBehavior: Only compatible upgrade targets can be selected.
